name: unseen-workflow-compiler
description: Source-grounded workflow intelligence for SOPs, policies, spreadsheets, playbooks, and multi-document business processes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn messy SOPs, policies, and spreadsheets into source-grounded flowcharts.
interface.longDescription: Compiles operational documents, SOPs, compliance policies, and playbooks into publication-ready visual flowcharts with verbatim source citations, deterministic $0 connector autofix, and bundled AI Enhance verification.
defaultPrompt: Compile this SOP into a source-grounded flowchart using Unseen.
Detect all candidate workflows in this policy handbook and map the approval gates.
Autofix the connectors and run AI Enhance on this workflow visual.
